kimi-k3.label: K3
kimi-k3.description: 2.8T parameter open-weight multimodal reasoning model. Strong at navigating large repositories, tool use, debugging, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Uses Stable LatentMoE with 896 experts (16 active).

deepseek-v4.1-flash.label: V4.1 Flash
deepseek-v4.1-flash.description: Efficient multimodal reasoning model for coding, computer-use agents, and long-context analysis. Supports native image understanding and a 1M-token context window.

deepseek-v4-pro.label: V4 Pro 0813
deepseek-v4-pro.description: General-availability release of DeepSeek V4 Pro. Large-scale MoE model for advanced reasoning, coding, and agent workflows with a 1M-token context window.

deepseek-r1.label: R1
deepseek-r1.description: A reasoning model that performs similarly to OpenAI's o3. It thinks before it responds.

grok-4.7.label: Grok 4.7
grok-4.7.description: Flagship reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Supports image and file inputs with a 500K-token context window.

llama-4-maverick.label: Maverick 4
llama-4-maverick.description: The largest of Meta's Llama 4 family. Cost-effective and comparable to DeepSeek V3 at coding

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.description: High-efficiency multimodal reasoning model with upgraded agentic capabilities, suited for focused tasks in multi-agent workflows. Supports configurable thinking levels.

gemini-3.8-flash.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini-3.8-flash.description: Multimodal Flash model with improved software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning. Supports text, images, files, audio, and video with a 1M-token context window.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
gemini-3.1-pro-preview.description: The latest preview version of Google's workhorse model, designed for reasoning, coding, mathematics, and scientific tasks. Has customizable reasoning parameters

mimo-v2.6-flash.label: MiMo V2.6 Flash
mimo-v2.6-flash.description: Open-source multimodal MoE model from Xiaomi with 309B total parameters and 15B activated per token. Supports reasoning, images, audio, and video with a 1.05M-token context window.

qwen3-coder-next.label: Qwen3 Coder Next
qwen3-coder-next.description: Open-weight coding model optimized for coding agents and development workflows. Sparse MoE with 80B total parameters, 3B activated per token, and a 256K-token context window.
